newsitem.title: NEW ZEALAND: Telecom to downsize Pacific Star.
newsitem.headline: Telecom to downsize Pacific Star.

text.p: Telecom Corp of New Zealand on Wednesday said it was downsizing its Australian subsidiary Pacific Star Communications and would offer four of Pacific Star's major business lines for sale.
Telecom said it was now in negotiations with Queensland Systems Integrations Pty over Pacific Star Technologies.

"As part of the sale process, Pacific Star Communications (PSC) has started a managed downsizing of the scope of its business in Queensland, New South Wales, ACT and Victoria," Telecom said in a statement.
The company would maintain its existing core business activities at current levels while it went though the sale process.

"Telecom has also decided it will offer the opportunity to individually purchase PSC's four major lines of business -- the two government contracts, corporate customers and Lane Consulting as well as PSC itself as a single entity," Telecom
As well as having a conditional contract of the sale of Pacific Star Mobile, Telecom was now in negotiations with Queensland Systems Integrations Pty over Pacific Star Technologies.
Ameritech and Bell Atlantic own 49.9 percent of Telecom. -- Wellington newsroom 64 4 473-4746
